images.title: Two rotis in a tiffin
images.purpose: Set up the question: 2 whole rotis and 4 children, so the child decides how to cut the rotis and share them equally.
images.composition: Two whole rotis on the left, four empty plates in a 2 by 2 square on the right, with wide white space, and one question line below.
images.exact_structure: Left: 2 round rotis of exactly the same size side by side, whole and uncut, filled plain with teal #0072B2 outlines. Right: 4 empty round plates of the same size in 2 rows of 2, outlined amber #E69F00. One grey #6B7280 arrow points from the rotis toward the plates. Caption under each group; question line centred at the bottom. No cut lines, no shading and no children drawn. Exactly 2 rotis, 4 plates, 1 arrow.
